description: Contributing to the development and optimization of MemeChat’s core backend systems built on Python and FastAPI.
Working on existing microservice architecture to improve performance, scalability, and fault tolerance.
Implementing efficient asynchronous task handling and communication through RabbitMQ.
Managing and optimizing MySQL databases for large-scale user and content data.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality backend features that support product growth and stability.
Lead a team of 10+ developers to build and maintain the company's flagship product, a comprehensive platform for managing and analyzing data in the financial services industry.
Developed and maintained a custom CMS for the company's website, allowing for easy updates and management of content.
Collaborated with the design team to create a user-friendly interface for the company's platform, ensuring a seamless user experience.
